about: Limmy Waking Up is a close-up of Scottish comedian Brian Limond, known as Limmy, lying shirtless in bed with his face mashed into a white pillow, hair sticking up, one eye squinting and his mouth twisted into a groggy, pained grimace. He looks like he has just been woken far too early or after far too little sleep, which is how the photo is used: the face of every rough morning, confused nap and alarm that went off at the wrong time.
origin: Limmy posted the photo on Twitter in September 2014, and it has been captioned as an image macro ever since.
usage:
Top box: the situation you are waking up into. Bottom box: the groggy thought or the bad news.

It fits naps that went too long, alarms on a day off, waking up to forty messages, or the moment you remember what you said last night. The best captions are something half-asleep you would actually mumble.
ideas: me waking up from a 20 minute nap
waking up after the group project deadline
